# Textures are PREMULTIPLIED (RGB = colour x alpha): load <name>.bmp + <name>_a.bmp with image flags 0
# and combine them (like hud_font.cpp load_page; IMG_ALPHA's bleed breaks premultiplied texels),
# RT_CLAMP | RT_NOMIP, bilinear. Draw with RB_PREMUL (ONE, INVSRCALPHA), vertex colour white; fade with
# (k, k, k, k) (scale RGB and alpha together).
# Records (integers, single spaces; ignore unknown records and extra trailing fields):
#   place <x> <y> <w> <h>        logo canvas rect in virtual 640x480 units (title screen)
#   set <name> <nativeLines> <pxW> <pxH> <tiles> <minScreenH>
#        the canvas is pxW x pxH texels; drawn 1:1 when screen h = nativeLines. Pick the set with the
#        largest minScreenH <= screen h (lo below 700 lines, hi from 700).
#   tile <set> <i> <texture> <texW> <texH> <u0> <v0> <w> <h> <offX> <offY>
#        the w x h texels at (u0, v0) of the texture cover canvas texels (offX, offY)..(+w, +h).
#        Each tile carries a 1-texel apron of neighbour content around that rect, so bilinear
#        filtering at non-native scales shows no seams. UV = (u0 / texW, v0 / texH) ..
#        ((u0 + w) / texW, (v0 + h) / texH); no half-texel inset.
#   small <texture> <texW> <texH> <u0> <v0> <w> <h> <scale1000>
#        the whole logo in one texture (pause / records headers): canvas = w x h texels at (u0, v0);
#        scale1000 = texels per virtual unit x 1000 (draw at w x 1000 / scale1000 virtual units for
#        a 1:1 look at 480 lines, or any size).
# Drawing (k = screen h / 480, f = screen h / nativeLines): X = round(placeX * k) (+ the horizontal
# centring offset of non-4:3 modes), Y = round(placeY * k); tile screen rect = (X + offX * f,
# Y + offY * f, w * f, h * f). At the native height f = 1 and every texel is one pixel (D3D TL: subtract
# 0.5 from x and y); at 640x480 the lo set draws at f = 0.8, at 1024x768 the hi set at f = 0.73.
